title: Best robot lawn mower deal: Save $200 on the Segway Navimow i215 robot lawn mower
excerpt: Get a great-looking yard without expending any effort.
content_html:
SAVE $200: As of Nov. 11, get the Segway Navimow i215 Robot Lawn Mower for $1,399 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,599. That's a discount of 13%.

Credit: Amazon

$1,399 at Amazon
$1,599 Save $200

Mowing the lawn is a somewhat thankless task that no one really wants to tackle. Luckily, in 2026, you don't have to spend time pushing around a lawnmower when a robot is more than happy to handle that for you. As part of the wave of early Black Friday deals on offer, we found a great deal on a robot lawn mower that can help you achieve a perfectly-manicured lawn in the blink of an eye.

As of Nov. 11, get the Segway Navimow i215 Robot Lawn Mower for $1,399 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,599. That's $200 off and a discount of 13%.

Mashable Trend Report

This model is simple to start up straight out of the box, so it can hit the lawn running, so to speak. It doesn't require antennas or boundary wires, and it uses one-tap auto mapping to help figure out where any potential obstacles are as well as the size and shape of your yard. That way you can turn it on and let it get to work without complicated setup.

The robot lawn mower relies on solid state LiDAR and onboard vision sensors to navigate from there, which can work in both day and night so it can handle yard work without the need for you supervising it in the sun. It can detect over 200 obstacle types, and you can further adjust its mowing area in its accompanying app with up to 20 mowing zones on an interactive map.

All this, powered by a 100W mower with a 6-blade disc to help it get up close and personal with out-of-control grass. If you're tired of manually mowing the lawn and want to outsource this responsibility, don't hesitate with this early Black Friday deal.
